apply: pred = base + adj; adj = sum_j coef_j * (x_j - mu_j) / sd_j

feature_defs.trend: (ppg_cur - ppg_ly) * g_cur / (g_cur + k_games), 0 if either missing, clip +-10
feature_defs.qepa_tr: (epa_cur - epa_ly) * db_cur / (db_cur + k_db), 0 if either missing, clip +-0.5
feature_defs.qualifying game: QB with attempts>=15, or the most attempts on his team (>0); REG season only
feature_defs.ppg: half-PPR mean over qualifying games (this season before week W / all of last season, any team)
feature_defs.epa: sum passing_epa / sum (attempts + sacks_suffered) over the same qualifying games
